title: Can Search Agents Correct Their Own Errors? Evaluating Retrieval, Evidence Delivery, and Answer Completion
abstract: arXiv:2611.30243v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A search agent can leave an earlier error unresolved by missing the right source, overlooking a relevant passage, or failing to revise and deliver the answer after receiving the evidence. We evaluate these possibilities on BrowseComp-Plus by replaying each model's own wrong closed-book answer in conversation and intervening on what evidence reaches the model. In a supplied-evidence study spanning four open-weight checkpoints, 709 questions and 26,665 test conditions, a confident assistant prior reduced Nemotron's paired accuracy by 16.1 percentage points despite answer-bearing passages in context. When the user insisted on the prior, accuracy fell by 32.9 points for Nemotron and 12.6 for gpt-oss. Among gpt-oss responses that lost correctness in that condition, abstention was more common than repeating the prior. In separate search interventions with Qwen3.5 and Nemotron, placing a gold page first often left the decisive source unopened.

translated_title: 搜索智能体能否纠正自身的错误？评估检索、证据传递与答案完成
translated_abstract: 搜索智能体可能因为错过正确的信息来源、忽略相关段落，或在收到证据后未能修改并给出答案，而使先前的错误得不到解决。我们在BrowseComp-Plus数据集上评估这些可能性，方法是在对话中重放每个模型自己给出的错误闭卷答案，并对模型接收到的证据进行干预。在一项涵盖四个开源权重模型、709个问题和26,665个测试条件的证据供给研究中，即使上下文中已包含含有答案的段落，一个自信的助手先前回答仍使Nemotron的配对准确率下降了16.1个百分点。当用户坚持先前答案时，Nemotron的准确率下降了32.9个百分点，gpt-oss下降了12.6个百分点。在该条件下失去正确性的gpt-oss回复中，弃权比重复先前答案更为常见。在对Qwen3.5和Nemotron进行的独立搜索干预中，将包含正确答案的关键页面置于首位往往导致决定性的信息来源未被打开。
tldr: 该研究通过重放模型自身的错误答案并控制其接收到的证据，系统评估了搜索智能体在检索、证据传递和答案修正各环节的自我纠错能力，发现即使正确证据在手，模型仍常受先前错误答案干扰而无法完成纠错。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates search agents' self-correction abilities across retrieval, evidence delivery, and answer completion by replaying their own wrong answers and controlling evidence, revealing that models often fail to correct errors even when answer-bearing evidence is provided.
